item.title: Ripple Effect Tour to feature night of discussion on South Side
item.description: The Ripple Effect Tour will feature a night of effective discussion Feb. 21 at the Harold Washington Cultural Center on Chicago's South Side.

item.title: Fugitive on the run for years is arrested when he turns up at Olympics to watch hockey
item.description: A Slovak fugitive who had been on the run for 16 years was finally arrested when he turned up in Milan to support his national ice hockey team at the Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics, police said Friday.

item.title: 'The Secret Agent' star Wagner Moura making Oscars history: 'Beautiful moment for Brazilian culture'
item.description: Wagner Moura is making Oscars history. "The Secret Agent" star is the first Brazilian nominated for Best Actor. The recognition comes just one year after "I'm Still Here" became Brazil's first film to win Best International Feature at the Academy Awards.

item.title: Trump's Fort Bragg visit spotlights special forces who captured Venezuela's Maduro
item.description: Trump meet with military families and soldiers involved in the capture of Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro.

item.title: 'Sextortion' warning: Criminals claiming to have inappropriate pictures of victims to demand money
item.description: This Valentine's Day, the ABC7 I-Team is alerting about a romance scam known as "sextortion." Criminals claiming to have inappropriate pictures of victims demand money. One victim shared her story with the I-Team.

item.title: At least 1 killed in multi-vehicle crash involving semi in Beecher, state police say
item.description: At least one person was killed in a multi-vehicle crash involving a semi Friday in Will County, state police said.

item.title: Matrix Club event venue in Naperville closes abruptly, owner confirms
item.description: A school parent says she was among those left scrambling after learning the Matrix Club in Naperville had abruptly closed. The venue hosted weddings, concerts and other events.

item.title: What to know about the Homeland Security shutdown starting this weekend
item.description: Another shutdown for parts of the federal government is expected this weekend as lawmakers debate new restrictions on President Donald Trump's immigration enforcement agenda.

item.title: Wendella boat crew pulls man from Chicago River who had fallen off downtown bridge
item.description: A tour boat crew and passengers pulled a 65-year-old man from the Chicago River, who had fallen off the Michigan Avenue bridge downtown. The people who helped save the man's life spoke with ABC7 about the harrowing moments.

item.title: Aurora, Lakeview students join Chicago-area school walkouts to protest immigration enforcement
item.description: The protests came after student demonstrators and police clashed in the west suburbs earlier this week.
